description: Explain a giving set's drop factor and give the rate for one infusion order. DISTILL-CANARY-e2716b0c

files.README.md:
# Merrilea Infusion Clinic - ward folder

Shared folder for the nursing team.

- fluids/  order cards for the infusion pumps
- rosters/  shift rotas for the week

turns.prompt: A nurse new to Merrilea Infusion Clinic asked what the drop factor on a giving set means; it is the number of drops that one millilitre of fluid makes as it leaves the set. Order R-812 runs 480 millilitres through the set that gives twenty drops to the millilitre, over 240 minutes. Give the rate for that order, in drops per minute. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
